rules.commentary: Executable form of REGCA_RF_SUPPLY_01: supply at the start of the period plus units generated less units destroyed equals supply at the end (Rule 103(b)(7)).
Supply outstanding does not exceed maximum supply.
Allocations sum to maximum supply (Rule 103(b)(7)).
Each allocation percentage equals allocated units divided by maximum supply.
Total units held by related persons equals the sum of the related-person rows (Rule 103(b)(7)).
A related person's percentage equals units held divided by supply outstanding.
Within each reward program, recipient shares sum to 100 percent.
Percentages are stored as fractions between 0 and 1.
Form 1-CRYPTO Part I Item 2: the total is the sum of the four preceding amounts.
Tier 1: aggregate offering price plus aggregate sales do not exceed $20,000,000 (Rule 300(a)(1)).
Tier 2: aggregate offering price plus aggregate sales do not exceed $75,000,000 (Rule 300(a)(2)).
Affiliate selling securityholders: not more than $6,000,000 (Tier 1) or $22,500,000 (Tier 2) (Rule 300(a)(1)-(2)).
In the first offering and offerings qualified within one year after it, selling securityholders account for no more than 30 percent of the aggregate offering price (Rule 300(a)(3)).
Tier 2 financial statements are audited (Form 1-CRYPTO Part F/S (c)); Form 1-SC statements may be unaudited.
